name: Runway
label: Runway
description: Official Runway Dev Tasks API at https://api.dev.runwayml.com. generate_video = POST /v1/text_to_video. image_to_video = POST /v1/image_to_video. Poll get_task = GET /v1/tasks/{id}. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth: StudioQuack secret api_key as Bearer. Header X-Runway-Version: 2024-11-06. Docs: https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/api/. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: generate_video: model + promptText (+ ratio/duration as required by that model). image_to_video: model + promptImage (HTTPS URL or type file resolved to URL). get_task: id. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"model":"gen4.5","promptText":"clouds flying by","ratio":"1280:720","duration":5}.

schema.label: contentModeration
schema.description: Official contentModeration object for generate_video / image_to_video, e.g. {"publicFigureThreshold":"auto"}. Omit for defaults.

schema.label: outputFormat
schema.description: Output container for generate_video / image_to_video. EXACT: mp4 | webm | gif | prores (text_to_video + proresProfile).

schema.label: proresProfile
schema.description: ProRes profile when outputFormat=prores on generate_video. Official values such as 422HQ.

schema.label: promptText
schema.description: Text prompt. Required for generate_video (gen4.5 max 1000 UTF-16 units). Optional extra prompt on image_to_video. Example: clouds flying over a coastline.

schema.label: promptImage
schema.description: Start-frame image for image_to_video. Platform file block or HTTPS URL string. Never inline multi-MB base64.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Task id from create for get_task (GET /v1/tasks/{id}). Status PENDING|THROTTLED|RUNNING|SUCCEEDED|FAILED|CANCELLED.

schema.label: ratio
schema.description: Frame ratio for generate_video / image_to_video. Model-specific, e.g. 1280:720 | 16:9 | 9:16.

schema.label: duration
schema.description: Clip length in seconds for generate_video / image_to_video. Integer as required by the model (gen4.5: 2–10). Example: 5.

schema.label: seed
schema.description: Integer seed for generate_video / image_to_video. Same seed + prompt reproduces the clip. Example: 42.

schema.label: audio
schema.description: When true, generate_video / image_to_video request native audio. Official boolean, not a file. Example: true.

schema.label: negativePrompt
schema.description: Things to avoid in generate_video / image_to_video. Example: blurry, text overlay.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Create returns {id}. get_task returns status and output[] URLs on SUCCEEDED. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx (task may still be PENDING).

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (id, status, output, failure, failureCode).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: EXACT: generate_video | image_to_video | get_task. Create does not return the video — poll get_task. Do not poll tighter than every 5s.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Runway developer secret (RUNWAYML_API_SECRET). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never logged. Portal: https://dev.runwayml.com

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Default model id for create. Live list: https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/models.md. Text or image to video: gen4.5, seedance2, seedance2_5, seedance2_fast, seedance2_mini, veo3.1, veo3.1_fast, grok_imagine_1_5, hailuo3, happyhorse_1_0, gemini_omni_flash. Image-only: gen4_turbo. Put model on INPUT so it is sent in the JSON body. Do not invent retired ids (gen3a_turbo). aleph2 is video-to-video (not this node's ops).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-HTTP-call timeout (create or get_task). Default 60. Floor 1. Do not wait for the video in one call — poll get_task.
